question: When was the Battle of Daruin, associated with Sepoy Mostafa Kamal, fought?

options.text: 16-18 April 1971, in the first weeks of the war
November 1971, just before the formal war

explanation: Daruin was fought on 16-18 April 1971, early in the war. A Bengali platoon held the position, and Sepoy Mostafa Kamal (Bir Sreshtho), killed on 18 April, covered the retreat. Pakistani forces retook Daruin.
